visual.general_description: Color photograph of an infant lying on its back on a purple patterned blanket, with thick cracked pale-yellow scale plates separated by red fissures over the face, scalp, trunk and limbs.
visual.detailed_description: Portrait-orientation color photograph. An infant lies supine with the head turned toward the left of the frame on a purple blanket printed with cartoon snails and animals, wearing a white diaper that covers the groin. The skin of the face, scalp, chest, abdomen, arms and legs is covered by thick, cream to pale-yellow plates that are cracked into polygonal pieces, with red fissures between them. The upper lip and lower lip are thick, red and turned outward around an open mouth, and both eyes are closed with reddened tissue visible at the eyelid margins. The scalp shows no visible hair. One arm rests beside the head and the other arm is raised at the upper right of the frame with the hand flexed. The raised forearm and both knees show red cracked skin. A white adhesive wrap lies around the lower leg on the right of the frame, and a red circumferential band surrounds the ankle of the lower leg at the lower right. In the background are gray cables, clear plastic equipment and a white strip printed with the letters D and C. No panel letters, arrows, scale bars or printed measurements are visible.

visual.general_description: Color photograph of an infant lying on its back on white gauze cloths, with yellow-brown cracked scale plates over the face and scalp and red skin on the trunk and legs, with tubing and a blue stopcock beside the arm.
visual.detailed_description: Portrait-orientation color photograph. An infant lies supine on layered white crinkled cloths over a purple blanket, with a light blue pacifier beside the head. The skin of the face and scalp is covered with yellow-brown, finely cracked scale plates, and the skin of the neck, chest and abdomen shows red areas with flaking. Red, outward-turned eyelid tissue is visible at both eyes and whether the eyes are open or closed cannot be determined; the nostrils are visible and the lips are pink with the mouth slightly open. No hair is visible on the scalp. The arm on the left of the frame is bent upward with a flexed hand and glossy, red-brown skin on the forearm. A white diaper is in place with a piece of white gauze tied at the abdomen and a thin clear tube or wire crossing it. Both legs show raw-appearing red areas around the knees and shins, and an orange adhesive wrap is around one foot. An orange tube with a blue three-way stopcock lies at the left edge, and the edge of the incubator and a checked wall pad are visible at the right. No panel letters, arrows, scale bars or printed measurements are visible.
